narrative.overview:
A light, familiar product site whose signature is the transit network. Each app is one coloured line; the encrypted shared folder on the phone is the interchange where every line meets. The structure is ordinary SaaS on purpose (framed hero, cards, panels, a dark closing band), and the map carries the identity: line inks, station rings, dashed planned routes, lines that draw in once.

The suite site is near-white paper, ink-navy type and Geist. Each app page is its own world: the shell sets `[data-app]` and the page swaps ground, ink and display face (Fitnexx charcoal and scarlet with Big Shoulders Display; Finance warm graphite and amber with Fraunces; Pantry cream and leaf green with Bricolage Grotesque), while keeping the shared header, footer and line motif. Surfaces sit on soft two-layer shadows; depth is gentle, never dramatic.

Density is relaxed on marketing pages (7rem section rhythm, 80rem container) and tighter on the dashboard, which reuses the same tokens, cards and chart inks.
keyCharacteristics: Light near-white ground, ink-navy text, Geist Variable throughout the suite.
One line ink per line, carried by thick round-capped strokes and ringed stations.
Per-app worlds via `[data-app]`: own ground, brand ink and display face.
Soft two-layer shadows; 0.75rem base radius, rounded-2xl cards, 1.75rem hero panels, pill buttons.
Planned is always dashed: lines, badges, rings and empty states.

rules.name: The One Ink Per Line Rule
rules.body: Every line ink belongs to one line: scarlet Fitnexx, amber Finance, green Pantry, cobalt the dataset. Inks appear as lines, stations, series and brand, never as decoration; a new app gets a new ink.

rules.name: The Brand Follows The Page Rule
rules.body: UI reads `--brand`, never a fixed ink. On the suite it is cobalt; under `[data-app]` it is that app's line ink, so focus, selection, buttons and badges re-colour with the world.

rules.name: The Display Face Stays In Its World Rule
rules.body: `font-display` is used only for app names, app-page headings and stop names. Body, labels and the suite headline stay in Geist.

rules.name: The Tabular Data Rule
rules.body: Numbers in tables, charts and stop counters use tabular figures (`.tabular`, `.dashboard-chart`); headline figures switch back to proportional.

rules.name: The Lift On Focus Rule
rules.body: A card rises (`-translate-y-1`, soft to lift) when hovered or when its line is focused on the map; nothing else animates elevation.

dos: Do read colour through tokens (`--brand`, `--foreground`, `LINE_INK`) so `[data-app]` can re-theme a page.
Do draw lines with round caps, 45/90 degree bends and ringed stations; dash everything planned.
Do use `--shadow-soft` at rest and `--shadow-lift` for raised or lit surfaces.
Do keep cards at `rounded-2xl`, hero panels at 1.75rem and buttons as pills.
Do label illustrative app UI or data as illustrative until real screenshots exist.
donts: Don't use a line ink for anything that is not its line, its series or its page's brand.
Don't use gradient hero backgrounds or gradient text; gradients exist only as line dashes and the train pulse.
Don't put "Get started" on every CTA; name the action ("Explore the apps", "Get Fitnexx").
Don't use the app display faces outside app names, app-page headings and stops.
Don't fabricate screenshots, logos, numbers or testimonials.
